features: End-to-end integration validation across all Phase 1.5 features
Cross-feature regression testing and edge case hardening
Documentation and README updates for new CLI flags and behaviors

criteria.name: e2e_phantom_sprint_prevention
criteria.description: Running the harness against a spec with inline sprint references in prose, blockquotes, and acceptance criteria produces exactly the correct number of sprints matching only line-start headings — no phantom sprints are executed

criteria.name: e2e_resume_full_cycle
criteria.description: A full resume cycle works end-to-end: interrupting after sprint 2, resuming with --resume reuses existing contracts from disk, skips completed sprints, creates new timestamped log files without overwriting originals, and the checkpoint revert uses git reset --hard with .adhd/ stash/unstash

criteria.name: e2e_commit_adhd_flags
criteria.description: Running with --commit-adhd produces [adhd] commits containing contracts/feedback/progress/spec after each sprint, and --commit-adhd-logs additionally includes .adhd/logs/. Running without either flag produces no [adhd] metadata commits

criteria.name: e2e_notifications
criteria.description: All HITL gates (spec approval, contract review, evaluation review) emit terminal bell character. With --notify, desktop notifications are dispatched. Without --notify, no desktop notification commands are executed

criteria.name: progress_status_lifecycle
criteria.description: The progress.json status field transitions correctly through the full lifecycle: planning → generating → evaluating → (loop on failure) → documenting → complete, with 'documenting' appearing only when the Documenter agent is active

criteria.name: contract_parse_error_diagnostics
criteria.description: When contract parsing fails, a diagnostic file is written to .adhd/logs/sprint-N-contract-parse-error.txt with full raw text, a truncated preview is logged to console, and successful parses produce no diagnostic file

criteria.name: timestamp_log_consistency
criteria.description: All conversation log files (generator, evaluator, contract negotiation, documenter) use YYYY.MM.DD-HH.MM.SS prefix format. Multiple runs for the same sprint produce distinct timestamped files, and chronological ls ordering matches execution order

criteria.name: clean_working_tree_before_generator
criteria.description: Immediately before every Generator invocation, git status --porcelain shows no uncommitted .adhd/ files — they have been committed with an [adhd] prefix message

criteria.name: readme_cli_flags_documented
criteria.description: README or equivalent documentation describes --resume, --notify, --commit-adhd, and --commit-adhd-logs flags with usage examples and explains their interaction (e.g., --commit-adhd-logs implies --commit-adhd)

criteria.name: no_swallowed_errors
criteria.description: All try/catch blocks across shared/ and harness-claude/ either re-throw, log with context (including sprint number and phase), or return a typed error result — no empty catch blocks or catch blocks that silently continue

criteria.name: consistent_naming_conventions
criteria.description: Functions, variables, and types added or modified in Phase 1.5 follow consistent naming: camelCase for functions/variables, PascalCase for types/interfaces, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for constants. File names use kebab-case. No abbreviations without prior convention in the codebase

criteria.name: no_code_duplication_across_features
criteria.description: Timestamp formatting, git command execution, file-writing with directory creation, and notification dispatch each have a single utility function — no copy-paste patterns across sprint-counting, log-writing, contract-loading, or commit logic

criteria.name: sdk_separation_maintained
criteria.description: All new code in shared/ has zero imports from @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk or any provider SDK. Claude-specific code lives exclusively in harness-claude/. The AgentRunners DI interface is the only bridge between shared/ and provider implementations

criteria.name: biome_lint_clean
criteria.description: Running biome check across the entire codebase produces zero errors and zero warnings for all files modified or added in Phase 1.5
